description: escapeWorkflowCommands replaces every backtick with \` even when already preceded by a backslash, so redact(redact(x)) prepends another backslash on every call instead of being idempotent.

escapeWorkflowCommands replaces non-overlapping '::' pairs with '\:\:'; for an odd run of three or more colons, the trailing ':' of the replacement joins the next ':' to leave an unescaped '::' that a second redact() call then escapes.
